k_registrierenLead: You need an account to save and submit a listing. Searching works without one.
k_mailGesendet: If an account exists for this address, a message is on its way.
k_emailBestaetigenHin: To submit a listing your address must be confirmed. We have sent you a message.
sa_keine: You have no saved search alert yet.
sa_bestaetigtText: Thank you — from now on you'll receive notifications about new matches.
sa_bestaetigtFehlerText: This confirmation link is invalid or has already been used.
sa_abgemeldetText: You will no longer receive notifications for this search alert.
sa_abgemeldetFehlerText: This unsubscribe link is invalid or has already been used.
w_speicherFehler: The last change was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
w_konflikt: This draft was changed in another window. Reload the page to see the current state.
w_eingereichtText: We are reviewing your listing and will get back to you. You cannot edit it while the review runs.
w_bilderHin: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 8 MB maximum. Location data from the camera is removed.
w_exaktGesperrt: The exact address can only be published once we can verify it. Until then we show an area.
w_strassePrivat: Street and number stay with us. They never appear in the listing.
w_spracheHin: Which language did you write in? We do not translate automatically.
w_anmeldenNoetig: To save we need an account
w_anmeldenNoetigText: Your entries are kept. After signing in you continue where you left off.
m_nachrichtHin: The publisher sees this message. Write what specifically needs to change.
m_eigenesInserat: Someone else reviews your own listing.
v_hinweis: This is how your listing will look once published. It is not public yet.
w_schritt_absicht: What would you like to list?
w_schritt_typ: What type of property is it?
w_schritt_kontakt: How can interested parties reach you?
w_preisFehler: Enter a price or choose “on request”.
w_beschreibungFehler: At least 30 characters — describe location and condition.
w_ortFehler: Please choose a place from the list.
w_kontaktHin: Your details do not appear in the listing. Enquiries reach you through Fourwalls.
w_lageFrage: How precise should the public location be?
w_lageUngefaehrHin: About 450 metres — precise enough to be found, without showing the address.
w_lageGemeindeHin: About two kilometres. For properties whose location stays confidential.
w_gewaehlteBilder: Chosen images — the first is the cover
w_bereitText: We review your listing before it goes public. That usually takes a short while.
kl_lead: You can delete your account at any time. Some of your data is removed immediately; some remains for now — because it belongs to someone else, because it is an audit trail, or because how long it must be kept has not yet been decided. This page shows exactly what happens.
kl_exportHinweis: Want to keep your data? Download it first.
kl_nochNichtEntschiedenHin: No retention period has been set for this data yet. The system does not claim it has already been deleted — it remains until a legal review sets a period.
kl_dk_listing_entwurf: Your own drafts and listings under review, including photos
kl_dk_mail_outbox_ungesendet: Messages to your address not yet sent
kl_dk_audit_log: The system's audit trail (actions only, no content)
kl_dk_app_user: Your account itself (remains as an anonymous entry)
kl_dk_listing_organisation: Listings of an organisation you worked for — they remain published
kl_dk_org_membership: Your membership in an organisation's team (will be deactivated)
kl_dk_org_invitation: Pending invitations to your address (will be revoked)
kl_dk_listing_aktiv: Your own listings that were or are published — will be archived and no longer public
kl_dk_inquiry_gesendet: Enquiries you sent — remain in the inbox of the contacted provider
kl_soleOwnerTitel: You are the sole owner of an organisation
kl_soleOwnerText: Before you can delete your account, make another person an owner or put the organisation on hold:
kl_passwortHin: Enter your password again to confirm the deletion.
kl_fehlerAllgemein: That didn't work. Please try again.
kg_text: Your account has been deleted. Some of your data remains for now — because it belongs to someone else, because it is an audit trail, or because a retention period has not yet been set. These periods will be added once they are legally clarified.
